facts.value: Discover new cultures and broaden your perspectives with a study abroad opportunity during your studies, as an internship or job in research.
Discover the world with an ERASMUS study opportunity! Improve your language skills, get to know new cultures, and gain valuable international experience for your success in the job market.
Opportunities for teaching abroad are possible at many partner universities of Goethe University.
Information on searching, organizing, and promoting internships abroad, as well as important application deadlines has been compiled for you.
Teacher education students can find all information regarding internships abroad at the Academy for Educational Research and Teacher Education (ABL).
Here you will find helpful information on the implementation of the ERASMUS program and support for departmental cooperation.
Administrative and technical staff at Goethe University can find information on possible stays abroad.
